title: One Last Time, Forever
overview: Throughout the course of one perfectly mundane day together, Abby and Charlie are forced to ask themselves - is love enough?  Sure, they know and love each other, deeply. That much is clear. But when one emotionally charged fight exposes the deep truths they both continue to deny, it leaves a question mark on their relationship. Abby and Charlie are ultimately forced to decide if this relationship is something that is worth fighting for.
